先按高度与方块用途初分；你可以在俯视图框选、命名部位，再调整顺序。石砖和苔石砖可: Initial sections use height and block purpose. Draw regions on the map, name them and adjust their order. Stone and mossy stone bricks can share a wall group while retaining each source material. Dimensions are bounding ranges: leave empty cells empty.

例如：左塔、外墙、主屋: e.g. left tower, outer wall, main house
范围含首尾；后创建的分区拥有重叠方块，其他部分自动保留。: Ranges include both endpoints. Later regions own overlapping blocks; all other blocks are retained.

用所选方块设定地面基准: Use selected block as ground reference
